Enabling capture_svg processes inline SVG elements when extract_images is on

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { captureSvg: true, extractImages: true };
  const result = convert("<p>Below SVG:</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"><rect width=\"10\" height=\"10\" fill=\"red\"/></svg>", options);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
